stages.name: setup
stages.description: data and models for the probe

steps.name: setup_0
steps.cmd: cd {REPO}/data/py150 2>/dev/null && HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0 timeout 1h bash download_and_extract.sh; ls {REPO}/data/py150 | head

stages.name: probe
stages.description: every documented entry point, README order, minimal sizes

steps.name: env_vendored_transformers_4161
steps.cmd: cd {REPO}/transformers && pip install --no-index --no-deps -e . && python -c 'import transformers; print(transformers.__version__)'

steps.name: 2_sft_codexglue_external
steps.cmd: test -f {REPO}/code/run_lm.py || test -d {REPO}/CodeXGLUE || (echo 'SFT step is external (CodeXGLUE); no script in the artefact'; exit 2)

steps.name: 3_generate_score
steps.cmd: cd {REPO} && timeout 30m python generate_score.py --checkpoint_path PATH_OF_FINETUNED_GPT2 --mode score --model gpt2 --batch_size 1 --text_length 256 --min_query_len 10 --dataset_name data/final/jsonl --language python

steps.name: 4_train_estimator
steps.cmd: cd {REPO} && timeout 30m python train_estimator.py --batch_size 8 --run_name probe --epoch 1 --data_path PATH_OF_GENERATED_DATASET --metric gpt2_bleu --language python
